name: Moving Items
description: Items move by belts, chutes, funnels and arms.

pages.title: Moving Items
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Items move on **belts**, **chutes**, **funnels** and **arms**.
- Machines work on items on the belt or depot in front of them.
- Brass funnels and tunnels can filter. Andesite ones can't.
- An **Item Vault** is a big chest for belts and funnels.
Items move by **belts**, **chutes**, **funnels** and **arms**. Machines pick up what is on the belt in front of them.

pages.title: Mechanical Belt
pages.text: Needs [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#](). Carries items and entities. Place two shafts, link them with the belt, and machines can work on items riding it.

pages.title: Depot
pages.text: A stationary belt tile. Items sit on it, and a press, deployer or spout above can work on them.

pages.title: Brass Funnel
pages.text: Pulls from or pushes into an inventory. Place normally to pull, sneaking to push. Has a [#](7A3C9A)[filter slot](entry://glossary/filter_slot)[#](). The Andesite Funnel moves items unfiltered.

pages.title: Chute
pages.text: Drops items down. Needs no power. The **Smart Chute** adds a filter slot and extraction size.

pages.title: Mechanical Arm
pages.text: Assign input and output blocks by right-clicking them while holding the arm, then place it. Moves items between any inputs and outputs in range.

pages.title: Sorting with an Arm
pages.text:
The arm has no filter of its own. Sort with **Brass Belt Funnels**: when an output is a belt block with a funnel on it, the arm only drops items that funnel's filter passes there. Only that one belt block counts, not the rest of the belt.\
\
Select the belt block under the funnel as the output, not the funnel. The arm checks every output before it picks an item up, and leaves items no output takes where they are. A belt block with no funnel takes anything.

**Filters** go in funnel, tunnel or smart chute filter slots.

- [List Filter](item://create:filter): matches chosen items.
- [Attribute Filter](item://create:attribute_filter): matches by property (food, enchanted, and so on).

pages.title: Brass Tunnel
pages.text: Covers a belt and splits items to the sides, or sorts them by filter. Andesite Tunnels split one item at a time without filters.

**Storage**: the **Item Vault** is a big [#](7A3C9A)[multi-block](entry://glossary/multiblock)[#]() chest that connects to belts and funnels. A [#](2E5AAC)[Threshold Switch](entry://create_basics/redstone_and_control)[#]() reads how full a container is and outputs redstone.\
\
For networks that deliver by package, see [#](2E5AAC)[Logistics](entry://create_basics/packages)[#]().
